666.42 J/g - 487.31 J/g = 179.11 J/g

The onset temperature of the bare material is 231.93°C, and the onset temperature of the ZrO2 loading with the least heat (1.0 wt.% ZrO2) is 237.59°C.

The difference in onset temperature is:
237.59°C - 231.93°C = 5.66°C

This means that the onset temperature of the ZrO2 loading with the least heat is 5.66°C higher than that of the bare material.
